'''Nvon FlameStalker''' was a [[Force Adept|Force adept]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Holding the rank of "Force Tyrant", FlameStalker was the leader of the [[Force Assassins]], a group of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] that operated in the Dantooine system. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nvon FlameStalker frequently piloted a [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]] in [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] space.<ref name="SWG:DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Nvon FlameStalker]]
Nvon FlameStalker appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nvon FlameStalker was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Because Nvon FlameStalker spawned under the "generic_pirate" template, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset.<ref name="SWG:DS" />
